signal: unchanged Coqui TrendVol v4.2; identical prior completed Coinbase daily bar and anchor
selection: Report every variant in all three chronological development folds. Freeze one winner before opening holdout; require positive net-return lift versus unchanged execution in every fold and drawdown no worse. Otherwise retain baseline.
holdoutGate: No automatic adoption. Require positive net lift at base and doubled costs and no worse drawdown versus unchanged execution; report passive comparisons, turnover and missed favorable moves. Owner review plus independent forward evidence required.
missingData: Any missing required slot invalidates the fold. Do not impute or extend dates after seeing results.
limitOrders: Not evaluated: no historical executable depth/queue tape. Require a separately registered TTL, fill and partial-fill model before a limit trial.
trialAccounting: Eight declared variants; synthetic functional tests only so far. All evaluated variants, including failures, must appear in reports. Signal parameters are never optimized.
